card.name: USP after injection diluent names
card.fires_on: The letter P completing "USP" right after diluent names such as Sodium Chloride Injection, Sterile Water for Injection or Dextrose Injection in reconstitution steps. Also fires weakly on a few other spots like a closing parenthesis after a date, "in" before a department name, and the end of "hydrochloride".
